meta.title: Code in Motion diagnostic preview
meta.description: Disposable WordPress Playground POC for the CiM diagnostic Experience.
meta.author: Localis

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$page = get_page_by_path( 'cim-diagnostic', OBJECT, 'page' );
$post = array(
    'post_title'   => 'Code in Motion Diagnostic',
    'post_name'    => 'cim-diagnostic',
    'post_type'    => 'page',
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_content' => '[cim experience=\"synthetic-wordpress\"]CiM diagnostic fallback.[/cim]'
);

if ( $page ) {
    $post['ID'] = $page->ID;
}

$result = wp_insert_post( $post, true );
if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( $result->get_error_message() );
}
